what_it_does: QuaLITi studies how to select the best quantum hardware for machine learning tasks. NISQ computers (Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum) are quantum computers that are still prone to errors and have limited qubits. Quantum machine learning algorithms are iterative—they run many times with specific execution counts (shot counts)—making it impractical to optimize for just one piece of hardware. This paper empirically evaluates quantum classifier training and inference across multiple quantum backends with different qubit technologies and connection topologies, analyzing queue wait times and how hardware choice impacts overall performance.
